[SWS_DM_00487] Ignoring UDS message reception because of unknown target
address
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04168
⌈
If the DM is not able to process the indicated UDS request, because the indicated
target address is unknown to DM, it shall return a
std::pair
with
apext::
diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportProtocolMgr::IndicationResult
